name: Offer Type 7 Code
definition: Specifies the conditions that apply to the offer.

DISS.name: Dissenter Rights
DISS.definition: Securities holder has the right to disagree with a mandatory event. This right is not inherent in all offers and therefore must be noted in announcements only when applicable.

ERUN.name: Restriction Exchange
ERUN.definition: Exchange of Restricted to Unrestricted (or vice versa).

FINL.name: Final Offer
FINL.definition: Final or last offer to holders subject to offer conditions being reached, for example, 50 percent accepted on a tender.

PART.name: Partial Offer
PART.definition: Offer made by the offeror for a portion of the outstanding shares not already owned by the offeror.

SQUE.name: Squeeze Out Bid
SQUE.definition: Offer launched by a company, in possession of a large number of the shares (90% - 95%) of a company (generally as a result of a tender offer), in order to acquire the remaining shares of that company.

NDIS.name: Dissenter Rights Not Applicable
NDIS.definition: Dissenter’s rights are not applicable for this option of the offer.

ACPR.name: Acceptance Priority
ACPR.definition: Event will be paid in a particular priority stated in the offering documentation. Higher tiers of securities will be paid ahead of lower tiers of securities.
